To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the main challenges of MOOCs are the lack of interaction with students, and that the main challenge of SPOCs is to make the students feel that they are not being treated differently from other students.

the use of educational technologies in the university context has been boosted by the appearance of MOOC platforms and that the use of these platforms is a very good starting point for the implementation of a new educational technology in a university context.
the use of educational technologies, such as MOOCs and/or SPOCs, in universities, has to take into account the specific characteristics of each university and each course.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: How to design a MOOC or SPOC? How to assess the learning of students? How to measure the impact of these courses? How to manage and organize the work of a MOOC team? In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MOOCs are not a panacea for education, and that they are not a threat for universities.
MOOCs are a great opportunity for the future of education, but that we need a lot more research in this field.
MOOCs are still an emerging technology, which needs to be studied and understood.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to carry out MOOCs and to adapt our own learning management system to support the SPOC model.
MOOCs and SPCCs can be a great opportunity to improve the teaching-learning process and to enhance the quality of education.
we have developed 3 MOOCs and 4 SPOCs, which were attended by a total of more than 1,500 students.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MOOC model is not suitable for all courses and that it is not enough to simply translate a face to face course into a MOOC.
, despite the fact that MOOCs are a great way to disseminate knowledge, they also have a great potential in improving teaching and learning processes in the university.
MOOCs and SPCCs are not only about technology, but also about pedagogy.
